description: Propose nav wiring + blog collectionization for an imported mirror (draft, opt-in). Read-only; returns per-adapter reports + proposalEtag. Nav decline may include nextStep (e.g. mega-menu → edit fragments/header.html). Wait for mirror-vs-editable answer if requiredDecision pending.

full.description: Return the full per-member harvest report (default: compacted for the token budget).

basePath.description: Index route path override, e.g. "/blog" (default: the index route).

fragment.description: Chrome fragment name the nav adapter reads (default "header").

index.description: Blog index content key (default: probe blog.html, posts.html, …).

menu.description: Menu name the nav adapter wires (default "primary").

pageSize.description: Explicit page size (default: visible card count).

prefix.description: Member key prefix override, e.g. "post/" (default: detected from index card links).

refreshProposal.description: Replace an existing UNCONSUMED proposal (otherwise re-analyze 409s proposal_exists).

name: adapt_site_analyze
